# GNOME-Wine icons (bundled)

Source: GNOME-Wine / GNOME-Colors icon theme (wine-red colour variant).
Upstream project: [GNOME-Colors](https://github.com/gnome-colors/gnome-colors) — **GPLv2 or later**.
The zip supplied for Libreworks 0.3.8 contained no COPYING file; the GNOME-Colors project is licensed GPLv2+.

Libreworks embeds only the freedesktop icon names it uses (plus a few created substitutes in the same palette).
